AK-12M.description:
Fourth generation of the AK-12 development cycle.

Based on the AK-400 prototype, it incorporates many of the ergonomic improvements of the early generation AK-12s while heavily simplifying production costs and internal complexity. Accurate much like the earlier AK-74M that it replaces in service - so long as you don't touch the dust cover.

Model submitted by Mysterious Modeler X
AK-12M.name: AK-12M

M16A4.description: A modernized assault rifle based on the AR-15 as used by the Grand Federation military, featuring a burst-fire trigger group. Very accurate with low recoil and a long effective range.
M16A4.name: M16A4

QBZ-97A.description:
The QBZ-97A is an export variant of the QBZ-95 designed to use the more traditional 5.56x45mm NATO round.

While it shares a lot in common with the QBZ-95, it possesses a redesigned trigger guard, a deeper magazine well, and the addition of a three round burst mode.

Community submitted model.
QBZ-97A.name: QBZ-97A

STG-44.description: The first successful assault rifle design, firing the intermediate 7.92x33mm Kurz cartridge. Its name, 'Sturmgewehr' translates to 'assault rifle' in English and became the designation for a new weapon type, it by no means was the first assault rifle however. This weapon has great damage in close range, but a slow rate of fire.
STG-44.name: STG-44

AK47.description: A Zarovian assault rifle. The most common rifle in the world, firing a heavy intermediate cartridge. High damage, high recoil.
AK47.name: AK47

G11K2.description:
A prototype Eisenmarkian assault rifle that fires caseless rounds, allowing for more bullets in the same space. It features an incredibly fast 3-round burst mode, but otherwise fires very slowly. It is mechanically complex, making it unwieldy and bulky.
Wait a minute, this is the future. Where are all the phaser guns?
G11K2.name: G11K2

AS VAL.description: A tactical upgrade to the SR-3M, with a large suppressor for the purpose of being used by Zarovian special-ops troops. High damage up close, but lacking damage at range.
AS VAL.name: AS VAL

AUG UNBULLPUP.description:
A strange design of the UAR in unbullpuped form, yet performs identically to the UAR A1.
How does this even work?

Model submitted by Rialag.
AUG UNBULLPUP.name: AUG UNBULLPUP

AK-19.description:
The AK-19 is a variant of the AK-12 chambered in 5.56x45mm NATO intended for export. It is based on the AK-12M, the 2020 upgrade of the AK-12, fitted with a new L-shaped stock and other various improvements to the ergonomics of the firearm. It lacks the burst-fire capability of the earlier models.

Model submitted by Mysterious Modeler X
AK-19.name: AK-19

AK-15.description:
A variant of the AK-12 chambered in 7.62x39mm, developed alongside the AK-12 in the "Ratnik" modernisation program and intended to replace the AK-103 and AKM in service.

Model submitted by Mysterious Modeler X
AK-15.name: AK-15

AK12.description:
The prototype AK-12, first unveiled in 2012, was the final design of Mikhail Kalashnikov before he passed away. It features new ambidextrous fire controls, a novel 3-round 'hyperburst' system, and a heel magazine release amongst various other significant upgrades. While generally considered a fairly significant improvement to the earlier AKs, the AK-12 izd. 2012 prototype was ultimately not adopted due to high costs, complexity, and lack of parts commonality with existing AKs.

Jack-of-all trades gun with a unique burst-fire mode that increases the weapon's power significantly if you can use it right.

Model submitted by Rialag
AK12.name: AK12

IA2 AR.description:
A Selvazian assault rifle designed by IMBEL to replace the FAL and M16A2 in service with the Selvazian military.

Having been designed as an upgrade to the MD-97 - a Selvazian modernized FAL which never entered service - the gun shares many common parts with MD-97 and by extension the FN FAL rifles.
IA2 AR.name: IA2 AR

FAMAS F1.description:
A Lysorian bullpup assault rifle.
One of the two main variants, both were accepted into the Lysorian military in the late 1978s and are being phased out slowly with the M416.
The FAMAS F1 uses a proprietary 25-round magazine with Lysorian made ammo and a smaller trigger guard. It is the slowest firing variant but hits the hardest.
Burst fire reduces recoil by 20% and increases RPM by 100!

Model submitted by Mysterious Modeler X.
FAMAS F1.name: FAMAS F1

M16A3.description: A traditional AR-15 platform assault rifle as used by the Grand Federation military. This version features a fully automatic trigger group. Accurate with low recoil and a fast reload.
M16A3.name: M16A3

AEK-971.description:
A Zarovian assault rifle chambered in 5.45x39mm that features a balanced automatic recoil system designed in the late 70s.
The AEK-971 lost to the AN-94 in selection trials but small batches were adopted for service anyway.
Features a high rate of fire with very low recoil which is lowered even further when using the optional burst firemode.

Model submitted by Mysterious Modeler X.
AEK-971.name: AEK-971
